content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization at time of service. This payer does not offer retroactive authorization and does not offer peer-to-peer review, so those paths are closed. An appeal with medical necessity was already filed and doesn't cure a missing auth. The auth requirement was not met and no available action can properly recover payment; this is a nuanced write-off/appeal-limitation decision better handled by the conservative specialist.","action":"escalate"}
